messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Metering check failed for billing-dashboard service (incident_id=INC-2026-048). Severity: high. Alert rule: 'billing-usage-null-rate > 5%'. Paged: @oncall. Root: usage API returning null/empty payloads for some tenants since ~00:05 UTC.

Alex Chen: I'm on it. Seeing 500s from /v1/usage/summary for requests with window=TODAY. Error looks like: `NullPointerException` in metering-cache layer. Reproduced locally against prod-like snapshot.

Maria Gonzalez: I just checked the metering-flush cron that ran @ 00:03 UTC. It failed halfway with an OOM on the job worker, and the cache tombstoning step never completed. Rolling back the flush won't help, we need to rehydrate cache + replay ledger events for affected shards.

Ritesh Kapoor: Agreed. Proposed immediate mitigation: 1) suspend live metering-flush job to prevent further partial tombstones. 2) trigger `metering-rehydrate` job targeting shards with null responses. 3) start incremental reconciliation run for invoices due this week.

Maria Gonzalez: Taking step 1 now.

# suspend cron
kubectl patch cronjob metering-flush -n infra --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'

Maria Gonzalez: Cron suspension confirmed. Cronjob controller shows `suspend: true`.

Alex Chen: Kicking off rehydrate job for shard set [shard-03, shard-07, shard-12]. Running in batch to limit load. Command: 

```
kubectl create job rehydrate-shards-03-07-12 -n metering --image=redwood/metering-tools:prod -- /bin/rehydrate --shards=03,07,12 --concurrency=2
```

Alex Chen: Logs (tail):

```
[rehydrate] shard=03 start
[rehydrate] shard=03 fetch-ledger OK
[rehydrate] shard=03 write-cache OK
[rehydrate] shard=07 start
[rehydrate] shard=07 fetch-ledger ERROR: timed out fetching 07
```

Sam Ortiz (oncall): I'm adding a short customer-facing status update. Suggest: "We are investigating an issue where some customers may see incorrect or missing usage on the billing dashboard. No billing charges will be applied incorrectly; we are reconciling usage and will follow up with corrected invoices if needed." Want me to post to status.redwood.ai? ETA: 30m for first update.

Priya Nair (CS): Please include guidance for customers: 1) No action required, 2) invoices may be delayed by up to 48 hours for affected accounts, 3) open a support ticket if you see an incorrect invoice after we confirm reconciliation.

Jess Park (Billing): Draft customer email for affected tenants (use mild language):

"Hello,

We detected an internal issue that caused the usage display on the Redwood billing dashboard to be incomplete for a subset of accounts. We are actively reconciling usage and will post corrected invoices if any adjustments are required. No payments will be processed until reconciliation completes. We expect an initial update within 2 hours and final reconciliation within 48 hours. If you'd like real-time updates for your account, reply to this message and we'll prioritize your reconciliation.

Sincerely,
Billing Team"

Ritesh Kapoor: I'll run a targeted SQL to reconcile the ledger for the shards we rehydrated. Sample query (dry-run mode):

```
BEGIN;
-- dry run: compute delta per tenant
SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS ledger_events
FROM ledger.events
WHERE shard_id IN ('03','07','12') AND created_at >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY tenant_id;
ROLLBACK;
```

Alex Chen: Rehydrate job progress: shard-03 completed OK, shard-07 had timeouts but retried and now progressing, shard-12 in progress. Partial success: ~42% of requests that previously returned null now return expected usage.

IncidentBot: STATUS UPDATE: Incident INC-2026-048 -> "Partial billing dashboard visibility". Impact: subset of tenants (estimated 6%) see missing or zeroed usage on dashboard; invoice generation processes delayed for affected tenants. Next update in 30 minutes.

Sam Ortiz (oncall): I'm drafting the status page entry now. Proposed copy: 

Component: Billing / Usage Dashboard
Status: Degraded performance (partial outage)
Impact: Some customers may see missing or delayed usage data; invoice previews may be incomplete. No double-billing expected.
Action being taken: Engineering has suspended the metering-flush job, started targeted rehydration jobs, and is running a reconciliation pass.
ETA: First update in 30 minutes, full resolution expected within 48 hours for all affected accounts.

Alex Chen: Reconciliation run started in dry-run mode to validate deltas. After verification, we'll run write pass with rate limiting. I'll attach the reconciliation plan to the incident doc (postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause, mitigation, customer impact, reconciliation steps, follow-up automations).

Maria Gonzalez: Quick note for ops: if you see `ERROR: rpc timeout` when fetching ledger for a shard, increment `--rpc-retries` and stagger retry windows so it doesn't overwhelm the database.

Jess Park (Billing): We should also prepare a template for customers who already got invoices during the window. Draft snippet: "If your invoice was generated during the incident window, it may be adjusted. We will notify you directly and apply any credits or revisions as necessary."

Priya Nair (CS): I'm prepping a prioritized customer list (top 50 by ARR) and will ask Sales/AMs to proactively reach out to any who are sensitive to billing timing.

Sam Ortiz (oncall): Handoff note for incoming shift (in 25m) -> @Ritesh you'll be primary; Alex will be secondary. Checklist for handoff:
- Current status: rehydrate jobs running, partial success ~42% fixed
- Next actions: complete rehydrates, run reconciliation write pass, monitor invoice pipeline for backpressure
- Communications: status.redwood.ai update every 30m, CS email template ready, billing will hold auto-charge until reconciliation done.

Ritesh Kapoor: Acknowledged. I'll take lead when Alex goes off shift. I'll prioritize shards with highest tenant density.

Alex Chen: Quick note: metrics to watch -> `billing.usage.null_rate`, `metering.rehydrate.success_rate`, `invoice.pipeline.backlog`. Adding ad-hoc dashboards now.

IncidentBot: UPDATED: Incident INC-2026-048 severity remains high. PagerDuty: escalation suppressed for duplicate alerts. Next automated check: +30m.

Sam Ortiz (oncall): Posting status.redwood.ai now.

[Sam posts on status.redwood.ai link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-048] :white_check_mark:

Alex Chen: Rehydrate jobs completed for shards 03 and 12, shard-07 finished after retry. Reconciliation dry-run validated deltas for 87 tenants. Starting controlled write pass with concurrency=4.

Ritesh Kapoor: Write pass started. I'll monitor DB load and throttle if queries spike.

Maria Gonzalez: After write pass completes, we'll trigger invoice preview regeneration for affected tenants. Jess, please coordinate hold on auto-billing until we verify previews.

Jess Park (Billing): Confirmed. Holding auto-billing for impacted tenants. Will prepare customer-notice broadcast once reconciliation finalizes.

Alex Chen: Write pass completed. Post-write verification: 92% of affected tenants now show corrected usage on dashboard. Invoice preview regeneration queued; expected to finish in ~45 minutes.

IncidentBot: RESOLVED: Partial restoration observed. Monitoring continues. Final status will be updated when all invoice previews finish.

Priya Nair (CS): Sending an interim customer message to the prioritized list now (using Jess's template).

Sam Ortiz (oncall): Official handoff: I'm handing to Ritesh for overnight monitoring. Ritesh, please post an update before you sign off in your local timezone.

Ritesh Kapoor: Will do. Thank you team.

Alex Chen: Post-incident action items for postmortem (short list):
- Root cause: metering-flush job OOM + tombstone step incomplete
- Short-term fixes: prevent partial tombstones, add pre-checks to flush job, improve retry/backoff on rehydrate
- Medium-term: better isolation for metering workers, circuit-breaker for cache tombstoning, end-to-end test for billing-dashboard pipeline
- Customer comms: final apology + summary + list of affected accounts + any credits applied
- Timeline & owners: assign in incident doc

Jess Park (Billing): Also note: run reconciliation reports daily for one week to catch late deltas; billing to follow up with accounting.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT CLOSED (monitoring phase). Postmortem required: due in 7 days.

Sam Ortiz (oncall): Adding final comment for handoff: pagerduty note created: `Incident INC-2026-048 - handoff to Ritesh - monitoring until invoice queue drained`.

Ritesh Kapoor: Acknowledged and taking ownership. I'll update the thread with final confirmation when invoice previews are all regenerated.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone. Great fast response. :thumbsup:"
